completeness.argument: Coverage is decided by distance, not by the request radius, because the discovery endpoint ignores its radius parameter and always answers with the globally nearest panorama. A coarse cell is marked empty only when its nearest panorama is further than the coarse spacing, so an empty cell contains no panorama at all. Every panorama inside a covered cell is within 141 m of a fine sample, which is inside the 250 m acceptance distance, so it is always detected.
completeness.emptyCellsMeaning: No Tencent panorama exists within roughly one coarse cell of the cell centre.

notes: Blue lines come from the ordered per-road point chains in the panorama metadata, so they follow captured imagery instead of the OSM road network.
Camera heading is filled only for panoramas whose metadata was fetched directly; panoramas enumerated from a neighbouring chain keep a null heading and render as dots.
Tencent coverage in Lishui is concentrated on major roads; the exhaustive grid is what proves which cells have no imagery at all.
